g.title: Ganglion cell layer (piled up at the foveal rim)
Outer plexiform layer with Henle fibres (cone axons running sideways out of the pit)
Outer nuclear layer (cone nuclei piled up under the pit)
Rods (absent from the centre of the fovea)
Cones (the only photoreceptors in the foveal centre)
Retinal capillaries (stop at the edge of the foveal avascular zone)
Light reaches the foveal cones directly
